label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 004 ]

blocks.text: Two Colombian rhythms have a foreign origin. The `cumbia' was created by African slaves who were brought to the hot regions of the country to work in the gold mines. It was a sad song of these people who missed their families. In contrast_, the 'bambuco' has a white, Spanish origin. It was created in colder zones and used when the Spanish wanted to express love to their girlfriends.
